messages.author: 6db3c86d422c5ae9
messages.subject: Serial mediation model_No parametric output
parts:
Dear Lavaan community,


We are trying to run a serial mediation model based on imputed data set. However, we’re facing a strange situation, we will be much appreciated for any suggestions.


We have two mediators (M1, M2), one independent variables (X), one dependent variables (Y).


We first did multiple imputation in R using mice package, and then we defined mediation model as follows:


Model <- “M1 ~ a1 * X

M2 ~ a2 * X + d21 * M1

Y ~  cp * X + b1  * M1 + b2 * M2

ind_eff := a1*d21*b2”



Then we used the sem.mi() function:


sem.mi(Model, data_imputed)

fit <-sem.mi(model, dat_mut_IMP)

summary(fit,  standardized = T, fit.measures = T, test = "D2")


Then we got a warning of “Error in if (categorical.flag) { : argument is of length zero”.  Further, we can not obtain the parameter outputs, like path coefficents. Very appreciated for your help. 




Many thanks in advance for your time

Best, 
Tuan & Kexin

messages.subject: Re: Serial mediation model_No parametric output
parts:
Thank you She Fai for directing me to the site. I indeed update the lavaan.mi and used runMI(model, data = datawithmissing, m = 10, fun = 'see', miPackage = 'mice', seed = 12345). I got a warning like 

"Found more than one class "lavaan.mi" in cache; using the first, from namespace 'semTools'
Also defined by ‘lavaan.mi’"

Luckily, I still got coefficients for all the paths indicated in the serial mediation model after using 
coef(mod1)
standardizedSolution(mod1)

I even got confidence interval (CI) for the indirect effect using monteCarloCI(mod1)

Unfortunately, I have still do not know how to get CIs, and also p-values for the other paths. Could you and everyone as well suggest a solution for me to overcome the issue?

Kind regards, 
Tuan & Kexin

messages.subject: Re: Serial mediation model_No parametric output
parts:
I found a solution for the problem of printing summary like following. I installed lavaan again and called the related packages.

install.packages('lavaan')
library(lavaan.mi)
library(mice)
library(semTools)

 It works using summary() following
summary(mod1, ci = TRUE, fmi = TRUE, output = "data.frame") 
summary(mod1, ci = TRUE, fmi = TRUE, output = "text")

But I am not sure whether it will still be working for the next start of my RStudio
